graph.name: Ampos Multi-Region Architecture and Data Lake
graph.categories: Cross-Region CI/CD and Multi-Region Data Aggregation
graph.notes: Ampos uses a multi-region setup with Development and Staging/Production environments in Singapore, Staging/Production in Beijing, and a centralized Datalake in Tokyo. CodeBuild manages deployment to both global and China regions using KMS for secret management and CloudFormation for automated deployments. Glue aggregates data from RDS databases in Singapore and Beijing into S3 in Tokyo.
